canonical_project: ADB / Kyrgyz Government Green Data Center PPP Project
owner: Government of the Kyrgyz Republic / Ministry of Digital Development / ADB / PPP Center
notes: ADB consultant TOR says the government resolved to deliver a renewable-energy-powered green data center PPP, with potential site being finalized around Bishkek and feasibility/procurement support running from August 2025 to August 2027. InfraPPP reported an RFP for design, financing, construction, operation and maintenance near Bishkek in July 2025. Capacity in MW not disclosed; secondary sources describe roughly 300-500 racks.
